sections.title: How the population has changed on the Isle of Anglesey
sections.label: Select another local authority

sections.content: In 2024, the Isle of Anglesey was the 20th largest local authority in Wales, with a population of just over 69,000. Its population decreased by 0.2% compared with 2023, and has increased by 1.9% since 2001.

sections.title: Population density on the Isle of Anglesey
sections.content: In 2024, the population density on the Isle of Anglesey was 97 people per square kilometre, which was less than Wales (154), and less than the United Kingdom as a whole (285).

sections.title: Median age on the Isle of Anglesey
sections.content: In 2024, the median age on the Isle of Anglesey was 49 years, which was older than Wales (42 years), and older than the United Kingdom as a whole (40 years).
